closed_notes.conclusion: The six channel controls' +0x34 GBK strings (0x47AD08/0x47ACF8/0x47ACE4/0x47ACD0/0x47ACB8/0x47AC98) render as HOVER TOOLTIPS (text) only - never as static captions. The strings are drawn by 0x00417370, which is called unconditionally from the hover branch (+0x25==1) of the channel-control paint 0x00417640 at 0x00417719-0x0041771B. The tooltip is drawn at the cursor position (GetCursorPos 0x476240 + ScreenToClient 0x476234) with a 0x96FFFF light-yellow background brush and 1px black frame via GDI (measure 0x45E0C0, CreateRectRgn 0x476054, CreateSolidBrush 0x476064, FillRect 0x4762F0, DrawTextA 0x476280 flags 0x25 = DT_SINGLELINE|DT_VCENTER|DT_CENTER inside 0x45DE50). The normal paint 0x00417830 and the frame blit 0x00460240 never touch text; a +0x34 read-site scan of the whole window/control region shows the ONLY reads are 0x00417373/0x00417378 inside the tooltip renderer (ctor copies the string at 0x004175CD, subobject ctor zeroes the buffer at 0x00417622). The click path is unrelated to +0x34: hit dispatch 0x004149A0 has no +0x34 reads and injects separate command-template constants (0x47AD88/0x47AD84/0x47AD80/0x47AD7C/0x47AD70/0x47AD60) into the native EDIT box (SetWindowTextA 0x4762CC, HWND 0x8AA48C).

closed_notes.conclusion: Renderer 0x45DD70 is a thiscall with 7 stack args (ret 0x1C). Slot order, proven by direct disassembly: arg1 = target surface/device (offscreen GDI surface; fallback this->+0x1C when 0), arg2 = X, arg3 = Y, arg4 = textcolor, arg5 = bgcolor, arg6 = text (GBK, strlen'd), arg7 = font (HFONT; fallback this->+0x28 context default font when 0; the arg7 stack slot is additionally used as the HDC out-param of device->vt+0x44 and every GDI call in the body reads the HDC back from that slot). arg1 == 0 and arg1->vt+0x44 failure both bail to 0x45DE42 (silent return). At the chat message call site 0x4147F3: arg1=[0x8AB7C4] (CWHDXGraphicWindow+0x1C offscreen surface), arg2 = this+0x6C0 + this+0x18 (X), arg3 = this+0x6C4 + this+0x1C + row (Y), arg4 = msg->+0x00 (textcolor), arg5 = msg->+0x04 (bgcolor), arg6 = msg->+0x08 (text), arg7 = 0 (default font). [0x8AB7C4] is NOT written by any static store: the surface is produced by IDirectDraw::CreateSurface via out-param (lea this+0x1C pushed as lpDDSurface at 0x45D53D/0x45D602, call [ddraw_vt+0x18] at 0x45D552/0x45D617 inside 0x45D380, sole E8 caller 0x45D140).

HDC acquisition: ecx=[eax](surface vtable); lea edx,[esp+0x24](=&arg7 slot); push edx; push eax; call [ecx+0x44] = surface->GetDC(surface,&hdc) writing the HDC into the arg7 stack slot; result <0 -> bail 0x45DE42
arg5 = bgcolor: eax=[esp+0x1C](arg5); eax==0 -> SetBkMode(hdc,1=TRANSPARENT) via [0x476044] (0x45DDB3-0x45DDBA); eax!=0 -> SetBkColor(hdc,arg5) via [0x476050] (0x45DDC2-0x45DDC8)
